preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transferOwnership)

exploit_hint: As owner, call setMarketingWallet() to set marketing address to attacker-controlled address. Then perform token transfers to trigger fee collection, which will send marketing fees to the attacker's address. Alternatively, set marketing fee to 100% to drain all transfer amounts, or manipulate liquidity fees to extract ETH from swaps.
